messages:
Maya Chen: Quick check — I'm about to land a small API contract tweak for model routing. Changing `model_alias` -> `model_id` (string) and adding optional `routing_hint` enum: ["latency", "cost", "region_priority"]. Will this break any existing clients? 

Owen Patel: fyi the public SDK maps `model` -> `model_alias` right now. We have a migration story but need compat layer in gateway. Can we support both keys for 3 months? :thinking: 

Maya Chen: yes I'd prefer dual-accept for the interim. Gateway should prefer `model_id` if both present. Also adding header `X-Client-Version` so we can detect old callers. 

Raj Singh: quick question on fallback behavior — if a `model_id` isn't available in requested region, what's expected? auto-fallback to same-model-other-region or to a compatible variant? 

Lina Gomez: for Dedicated customers we want region affinity; for Hosted default we fallback across regions unless `region_priority` is explicit. In code we currently have a `fallback_order` list per customer. 

Owen Patel: implementation note: runtime has `compatible_variants` mapping (e.g., `rwkv-13b` -> [`rwkv-13b-q8`, `rwkv-6b`]). We should surface which variants are allowed as fallbacks and whether we permit cross-tier fallbacks by default. 

Maya Chen: proposal: default fallback order = same-model-other-region -> model-quantized-variant -> model-smaller-architecture. Add `routing_hint=cost` to prefer quantized variants. Make this explicit in the API docs. 

Raj Singh: sounds good. For the gateway, can we add an explicit `fallback_behavior` field with enum: ["region-first","variant-first","no-fallback"]? That'll make customer config and testing easier. 

Maya Chen: yes add `fallback_behavior` optional. If absent follow the default proposal. Update schema in openapi and bump minor. 

Owen Patel: PR incoming: #4872. Contains OpenAPI diff + compat shim that accepts `model_alias`. Tests: unit for parsing both keys, integration for fallback order. 

Maya Chen: pinging @Lina for test matrix — can you add cases that exercise `region-first` vs `variant-first` and assert token-cost differences? we want to ensure Optimize suggestions don't flip choices unexpectedly. 

Lina Gomez: will do. I'll add evals under `routing/compat` and a small perf test against devpool GPUs. ETA EOD tomorrow. 

infra-bot: deploy queued: canary api-gateway v2.3.1 -> env=staging by @owen. 

Owen Patel: deploying the shim to staging now. If someone can smoke test `/v1/generate` with both keys that'd be great. snippet: 
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model_id":"redwood/my-model@v1",
  "routing_hint":"latency",
  "input":"hello"
}
```

Maya Chen: I'll run quick smoke and confirm headers/logging. 

Lina Gomez: I ran the `region-first` matrix against staging and saw expected cross-region fallback. One note: logs didn't include chosen variant in 10% of fallbacks — adding more granular logging. 

Maya Chen: added `X-Client-Version` check in gateway and a short migration note in the changelog. I also left a review comment on #4872 about preferring `model_id` mapping in the router. 

Owen Patel: addressed review comments, added explicit `chosen_variant` in response metadata: `response.meta.chosen_variant` — that'll help downstream analytics. 

Raj Singh: doc question: do we need to indicate cost delta when a quantized variant is chosen? we should surface an approximate tokens-per-dollar estimate. 

Lina Gomez: Agree. Adding `response.meta.cost_estimate` (string like `~$0.0003/token`) makes sense. We'll keep as optional and only set when routing is non-default. 

Maya Chen: final ask: keep backward compat for 3 months, create redirect in docs from `model_alias` to `model_id`, and schedule a postmortem if we see >0.5% error rate after rollout. 

Owen Patel: noted. I'll merge after staging smoke. Thanks all :rocket:
